note: EPS growth percentages (6-8%, 8-9%) not split into separate facts, consistent with the dev Linde label.

facts.evidence: For the third quarter of 2026, Linde expects adjusted diluted earnings per share in the range of $4.45 to $4.55, up 6% to 8% versus prior-year quarter, with no expected impact from foreign currency translation.
Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $17.70 - $17.90 representing 8% to 9% growth

Full-year capital expenditures are expected to be in the range of $5.5 billion to $6.0 billion to support growth and maintenance requirements including the $8.1 billion contractual sale of gas project backlog.
